LightningComponentBundle.description: Rolls up Tasks and Events from a Firm account, its Office accounts, and their contacts and opportunities into a colour-coded, filterable timeline with Overdue/Upcoming sections and a detail reading pane.

property.name: monthsBack
property.label: History window (months)
property.description: How many months of past activity to include. Overdue, upcoming, and open items are always shown regardless of this window.

property.name: maxRecords
property.label: Max records per type
property.description: Safety cap on the number of Tasks and Events fetched (each).
